content:
nina (Product Designer): quick sync 3 compact prereq strip for private setup. three chips: Network | Agent | Keys. chips show short state and count and expand inline. link: https://figma.com/file/compact-strip

omar (PM): nice. main q: what exact chip wording? need to be scannable on first glance.

nina (Product Designer): proposal: 'Network: 1 issue of 4', 'Agent: all clear', 'Keys: 1 missing'. click to expand.

frida (Frontend): implementation notes: chips are <button>s with aria-expanded and aria-controls. add aria-live="polite" for status changes. ensure focus outline visible and not color-only.

vasu (SRE): when a check fails surface one prioritized remediation and a single copyable command. redact secrets in logs. provide KB link for full troubleshooting steps.

a11y-bot: accessibility nits: 1) don't rely on color alone; include text + icon. 2) contrast >= 4.5:1 for normal text. 3) copy button must update aria-live with 'Copied to clipboard'. 4) on mobile stack chips and ensure touch targets >=44px.

omar (PM): microcopy vote: success 'Ready to proceed', warning 'Action suggested', error 'Action required'. keeps tone helpful.

nina (Product Designer): will update figma copy to those labels and add a 'Show issues only' checkbox (role=switch) that persists in localStorage.

frida (Frontend): I'll prototype the chip component and toggle, run axe, and post results here. aiming for small PR by next Tue.

vasu (SRE): I'll draft the KB remediation templates and the redact policy.

a11y-bot: reminder: run axe-core once prototype ready and attach report.

nina (Product Designer): thanks all 3 will post updated link and tag reviewers when prototype is live.
